description.value: Coast Chilliwack Hotel by APA is a 110-room full-service chain hotel operated by Coast Hotels, situated close to downtown Chilliwack in the Fraser Valley. The property offers an indoor pool, sauna, hot tub, fitness centre, and on-site dining at Montana's BBQ & Bar, which serves smoked BBQ and comfort food. It sits a short drive from Highway 1 with free self-parking on site, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms the hotel is open and operational. The amenities page and main page together list free wi-fi, indoor pool, sauna, hot tub, fitness centre, EV charging (car-specific stations), pet-friendly rooms, 24/7 lobby market, and on-site Montana's BBQ & Bar serving food from early morning to late night. No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, drying areas, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content. Contact details (phone, address) on the website match OSM exactly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with a confirmed active website and bookable rooms; a valid overnight stop for touring cyclists in Chilliwack.
enrichment_extras.notes: EV charging on site is car-specific (one standard EV station and one Tesla station); not confirmed usable for e-bike charging.

Nearby evening food.detail: Montana's BBQ & Bar is on-site, described as serving in-house smoked BBQ, Canadian comfort-food favourites, and hearty breakfasts from early morning to late night

Vending machines.detail: Website lists a '24/7 lobby market' on-site
